name: 6-Monoacetylcodeine
summary: 6-Monoacetylcodeine (6-MAC) is an acetate ester of codeine in which the hydroxyl group on the 6 position has been acetylated. It is occasionally present as an impurity in street heroin and is typically created when attempting to create heroin from a solution of morphine in which some of the codeine from the original opium solution still remains.

pharmacology.text: 6-monoacetylcodeine is eventually metabolised into codeine and then into morphine.

uses.text: It is occasionally present as an impurity in street heroin and is typically created when attempting to create heroin from a solution of morphine in which some of the codeine from the original opium solution still remains.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It turns into codeine and then morphine in the body. Opioids cause drowsiness, nausea, itching, constipation and pinpoint pupils, and they can slow or stop breathing, so overdose can be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它在體內會轉變成可待因，再轉變成嗎啡。鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、皮膚癢、便秘與瞳孔縮小，並可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，因此過量可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它在体内会转变成可待因，再转变成吗啡。鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、皮肤痒、便秘与瞳孔缩小，并可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，因此过量可能致命。

fact.en: It appears in street heroin as a by-product, because opium contains codeine as well as morphine, and the acetylation step treats both alike. Finding it is a sign the heroin was made from opium rather than pure morphine.
fact.zh: 它作為副產物出現在街頭海洛因中，因為鴉片除了嗎啡之外也含有可待因，而乙醯化的步驟對兩者一視同仁。檢出它，就表示那批海洛因是用鴉片而不是純嗎啡製成的。
fact.zhHans: 它作为副产物出现在街头海洛因中，因为鸦片除了吗啡之外也含有可待因，而乙酰化的步骤对两者一视同仁。检出它，就表示那批海洛因是用鸦片而不是纯吗啡制成的。
